source_semantics.intent: Navigate from the authenticated Posts workspace to the Execution Center.
source_semantics.side_effects: Navigation only; no content mutation, execution enqueue, provider call, WordPress call, persistence write, approval mutation, or execution mutation.

laravel_runtime.tenant_derivation: tenantUrl derives and URL-encodes the target solely from FrontendContext.tenant.slug
laravel_runtime.visibility_contract: the control renders only when tenant.view + content.view + operations.manage + execution.view are all present

proofs: exact canonical operation identity and generator-backed ADAPTED state
active tenant slug is URL-encoded and no caller tenant target is accepted
control is hidden unless source and destination permissions are all present
canonical Posts and Execution Center route contracts remain guarded
guest, permission and foreign-tenant destination paths fail closed
navigation introduces no endpoint or mutation

terminality.basis: The real Posts workspace renders a tenant-derived permission-safe link to the existing guarded Execution Center; focused frontend/backend proof covers tenant isolation, authorization and navigation-only behavior.
